To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The LMS has reached a plateau of stability; (2) The PLE is a new trend that is changing how we learn and share knowledge; (3) LMS should become open and allow users to integrate their personal tools and resources into their learning experience; (4) The Moodle LMS is a good platform for the integration of personal learning environments.

the future of eLearning lies in the integration between LMS and PLEs.

the LMS should be opened up to the outside world, to become a part of the PLE and to allow the integration of external tools, services and content, in a flexible way, and in order to be able to take advantage of the benefits of the PLE.

the LMS should be opened and made flexible in order to become a PLE platform, and that this is possible with Moodle.
